# PocSomm

> PocSomm is an iOS app that puts a sommelier in your pocket. Scan a restaurant wine list to instantly see estimated retail prices, value assessments, and critic ratings for every wine; photograph a bottle label for tasting notes; match wines to your meal with AI-powered food pairing; or ask the built-in sommelier for suggestions. No account, no subscription — free to download with starter credits, then one-time credit packs.

PocSomm is made by Melkar, LLC, a husband-and-wife team. It is available on the
Apple App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760143052 (an Android version is
in development).

## Key features

- Wine list scanning: photograph any restaurant wine list (or import a PDF/URL)
  and every wine is identified and enriched with an estimated retail price, a
  value label (Great value / Fair price / High markup), its markup multiple
  (list price divided by retail, e.g. 2.4x), and critic ratings when
  available. A Best Value sort ranks the whole list from the lowest markup
  to the highest, and color filters narrow it to reds, whites, rosé or
  sparkling. By-the-glass and by-the-bottle entries are told apart.
- Bottle scanning: point the camera at a label for an instant plain-language
  profile — flavor, body, serving temperature, decanting and cellaring tips,
  plus full sommelier notes on demand.
- Food pairing: photograph the food menu, pick the table's dishes, then scan
  the wine list; every wine is ranked with a match percentage and the
  reasoning behind each pairing.
- Ask PocSomm: describe what you're eating and get wine suggestions, or browse
  the built-in grape encyclopedia (flavors, key regions, classic pairings).
- Personalization: 11 app languages (English, French, Italian, Spanish,
  German, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese, Swedish, Dutch, Korean), selectable
  currency & market so price estimates match where you are, adjustable value
  thresholds, and a choice of 1–5, 1–10, or 1–20 rating scales.
- History: every scan is saved on the device; wines can be rated and revisited.

## Pricing

- Free to download, with starter credits included.
- Each scan costs a credit or two depending on size; larger imports cost more.
- Top up with one-time credit packs (in-app purchase). No subscription, no
  account, and credits never expire.

## Privacy

- No account and no sign-up; scans, ratings, and history live only on the
  user's device.
- What the user asks the AI to analyze (a photo, an imported wine list, the
  chosen dishes, or a question) is sent to Google's Gemini service only to
  produce the answer; it is never stored on PocSomm servers (there are none)
  and never sold.
- No ads, no cross-app tracking.

## Pages

- [Home](https://pocsomm.com/): product overview, features, screenshots, FAQ
- [Wine guides](https://pocsomm.com/guides): index of all guides and tools below
- [Wine markup calculator](https://pocsomm.com/wine-markup-calculator): free tool; enter the restaurant price and the shop price of a bottle or glass to get the markup and a verdict (1.75x or less great value, 1.75x-3x fair price, 3x or more high markup)
- [How much do restaurants mark up wine?](https://pocsomm.com/how-much-do-restaurants-mark-up-wine): sourced guide to typical restaurant wine markups, by the glass and by the bottle
- [How to tell if a wine on a restaurant list is good value](https://pocsomm.com/how-to-tell-if-restaurant-wine-is-good-value): step-by-step method (list price divided by local shop price), with how cheap bottles, glasses and country change the picture
- [How to choose wine from a restaurant wine list](https://pocsomm.com/how-to-choose-wine-from-a-restaurant-wine-list): budget, glass or bottle, food matching, value and how to talk to the sommelier
- [Best apps to scan a restaurant wine list (2026)](https://pocsomm.com/best-apps-to-scan-a-restaurant-wine-list): comparison of Noir, PocSomm, CellarTracker, Vivino, Sommo, Vinea, Tastello, Cellar Wine Scanner and Wine-Searcher; written by PocSomm's makers, competitor facts from each app's own listing, checked 17 Nov 2026
- [PocSomm vs Vivino](https://pocsomm.com/pocsomm-vs-vivino): ratings and marketplace (Vivino, list scanning needs Premium) vs price fairness and food pairing with no subscription (PocSomm)
- Every guide above is also available in French, Italian, Spanish, Japanese and Chinese: same path under /fr/, /it/, /es/, /ja/ or /zh/ (e.g. https://pocsomm.com/fr/wine-markup-calculator).
- [Privacy Policy](https://pocsomm.com/privacy-policy)
- [Terms of Service](https://pocsomm.com/terms-of-service)
